entities.name: Liana
entities.description: A young Simic researcher and apprentice to Florin Ozbolt who flees after he transforms himself into Experiment One.

entities.name: Florin Ozbolt
entities.description: Simic scientist who experimented on himself, becoming an ooze-like being called Experiment One.

entities.name: Experiment One
entities.description: The ooze-bodied form Florin Ozbolt takes after self-experimentation, who tells Liana to remake herself.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild that wields power over life; Liana and Florin's guild.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Liana becomes Florin Ozbolt's apprentice after Florin seems to agree with her philosophy of using Simic power to improve lives.
events.quote: Master Florin seemed to agree and thus accepted her as an apprentice.

events.summary: Liana and Florin test a limb-replacement therapy on rats with a mimetic ooze.
events.quote: The pair spent their first time together working on an innovative limb-replacement therapy

events.summary: They debate ethics of self-experimentation, and Liana reluctantly agrees to its nobility.
events.quote: Florin asked Liana if she was ready for such a thing, and she reluctantly agreed.

events.summary: The rat's ooze-graft succeeds, and Florin prepares to proceed with Experiment One.
events.quote: The scientist was now ready to proceed with the cryptic test that he called Experiment One .

events.summary: Liana returns to find the lab abandoned and the ooze in the tank moving; it leaps from the vat.
events.quote: Suddenly, the ooze launched itself out of the vat

events.summary: Liana realizes the ooze has taken Florin's shape, and Florin speaks, saying he has bettered himself.
events.quote: he told her he had bettered himself, just as they had spoken of in their debates

events.summary: Florin urges Liana to enter the vat; she flees the lab.
events.quote: She kept running, and she did not look back.
